main_text.p: verba erant rogatæ Legis, ut Hierarchia Ecclesiæ in Radice & Germine aboleretur, quod & frequens usurpabant in seditiosis Orationibus & Clamoribus.

p.i: Ita enim omnes vocabant, qui Regi adhærebant, in defensione Prærogativæ suæ & Legum, quos invisos Populo reddebant ut malos Consiliarios, & Arbitrarii Regiminis Promotores, &c.

main_text.head: CAP. X.
main_text.p: Gloriosum Me Regem effecturos. Id enim quo Populum facerent, ubique venditabant se Regis commodis studere, & si sibi auscultaret Gloriosissimum effecturos.

p.i: Æ quolibet Rege Angliæ in Inauguratione sua susceptum.

main_text.head: CAP. XI. Quam Tyrones sint valdè in Re Politica.]

p.i: Multi valdè adolescentes, & tenui fortuna & educatione, Municipiorum praesertim Deputati.

main_text.head: CAP. XII. Rebellione Hibernica.]
main_text.p: Quæ (turbatis rebus in Anglia sed nondum Bello declarato) erupit.
Præposterum illum rigorem. ] Qui nec illis locum veniæ relinquebant, proscriptis fortunis & sub hasta positis; cum nondum Illos in potestatem redegissent.

page.notes: Marginal notes on the left are run-in side notes at paragraph starts. Printed spelling is kept (e.g. "Juramentum", "Gloriosissimum"); long s is transcribed as s. The initial of the last paragraph is printed as a large capital, read here as Æ with [?] not required on inspection. Run-in bracketed summaries are kept in the text as printed.
